requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have all markings clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have an approval marking whose size is based on the value for "a" defined in Table 1.
requirements.quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” is defined in Table 1.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the rear retro-reflector shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the rear retro-reflector shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.quote: The four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.

requirements.text: The sequential number of the rear retro-reflector shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the rear retro-reflector shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
requirements.quote: The symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the rear retro-reflector shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.

requirements.text: Where the approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark of the rear retro-reflector shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I.
requirements.quote: The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown below: Figure I Unique Identifier (UI)

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector of Class IA shall bear the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear 3.3.4.2.1. in case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall meet the requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval.
requirements.quote: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible, the requirements pertinent to the retro-reflector and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflector is intended to be installed shall be applied.
requirements.quote: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be so constructed that it functions satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to its efficient operation or to its maintenance in good condition.
requirements.quote: In addition, they must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.

requirements.text: The components of the retro-reflector or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.quote: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall be easy to clean.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not be rough, and any protuberances it may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.

requirements.text: While the retro-reflector is in normal use, there shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, the retro-reflector shall be so designed that the optical unit and filter cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.

requirements.text: The retro-reflecting optical units and filters of the retro-reflector shall not be coloured by means of paint or varnish.
requirements.quote: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.

requirements.text: When the colour of the retro-reflective device is tested, the retro-reflective device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1.
requirements.quote: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the retro-reflective device shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., the rear retro-reflector shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.quote: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: (a) The dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5;

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., the rear retro-reflector shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.quote: (b) The photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.; and

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., the rear retro-reflector shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.quote: (c) The physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.

requirements.text: The applicant shall submit ten samples of the rear retro-reflector for approval, which shall be tested in the chronological order as indicated in paragraph 5.1.7.
requirements.quote: The applicant shall submit ten samples for approval which shall be tested in the chronological order as indicated in paragraph 5.1.7.

requirements.text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples of the rear retro-reflector shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and, at least one hour after this test, examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.quote: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

requirements.text: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.quote: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.

requirements.text: These two samples of the rear retro-reflector shall be kept by the laboratories for any further checks which may be found necessary.
requirements.quote: These two samples shall be kept by the laboratories for any further checks which may be found necessary.

requirements.text: The first group of two samples of the rear retro-reflector shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
requirements.quote: First group: The two samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).

requirements.text: The second group of two samples of the rear retro-reflector shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
requirements.quote: Second group: The two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.

requirements.text: The third group of two samples of the rear retro-reflector shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
requirements.quote: Third group: The two samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.

requirements.text: The fourth group of two samples of the rear retro-reflector shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
requirements.quote: Fourth group: The two samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the rear retro-reflector in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.quote: A colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the rear retro-reflector in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.quote: A RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.

requirements.text: The verification of the RI of the rear retro-reflector shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.quote: The verification shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

requirements.text: When applying for approval, the applicant shall specify one or more or a range of axis of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI.
requirements.quote: When applying for approval, the applicant shall specify one or more or a range of axis of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI.

requirements.text: Where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements of the rear retro-reflector shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In the case where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the rear retro-reflector as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2 though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.
requirements.quote: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2 though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.

requirements.text: The manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area to be used for the photometric measurements of the rear retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: The manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area to be used.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values of the red Class IA rear retro-reflector shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown: at an angle of divergence of 20', 3.00·10^2 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°, 2.00·10^2 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°, and 1.00·10^2 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°; at an angle of divergence of 1°30', 5·10^0 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°, 2.8·10^0 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°, and 2.5·10^0 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
requirements.quote: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors must be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall not have RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the following lines: (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.quote: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the following lines: (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).

requirements.text: Where the rear retro-reflector of Class IA is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB, is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.

requirements.text: The testing of the colour of the rear retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
requirements.quote: The testing of the colour for retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the luminous flux reflected by the rear retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux must be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be tested in the chronological order of tests given in Table 4 (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB).
requirements.quote: Chronological order of tests Table 4 Chronological order of tests (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB)

requirements.text: When the RI of the rear retro-reflector is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.
requirements.quote: When the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.

requirements.text: When the RI of the rear retro-reflector is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0° and a mirror effect is produced, a reading shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.quote: If there is any such effect, a reading shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', the rear retro-reflector, if not marked "TOP", shall be rotated about its axis of reference to the position of minimum RI.
requirements.quote: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The minimum RI of the rear retro-reflector, if not marked "TOP", shall conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: ...to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the rear retro-reflector, if not marked "TOP", shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε.
requirements.quote: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', the rear retro-reflector, if marked "TOP", shall be rotated about its axis ±5°.
requirements.quote: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°.

requirements.text: The RI of the rear retro-reflector, if marked "TOP", shall not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
requirements.quote: The RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.

requirements.text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI of the rear retro-reflector exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
requirements.quote: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the retro-reflective device of Class IA or IB shall have a shape that is not easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.quote: The shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.

requirements.text: In the resistance to heat test for moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C, after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.
requirements.quote: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.

requirements.text: In the test for resistance to water penetration, the retro-reflective device, whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.

requirements.text: In the test for resistance to water penetration, the immersion test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.quote: This test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: In the test for resistance to water penetration, the sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.quote: These sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.

requirements.text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit of the retro-reflective device.
requirements.quote: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.quote: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, in the case of retro-reflectors, the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.quote: In the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.

requirements.text: In the dust exposure test, a sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as follows:
requirements.quote: A sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as follows:

requirements.text: In the dust exposure test, the mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall.
requirements.quote: The mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall.

requirements.text: In the dust exposure test, devices with a length exceeding 600 mm shall be horizontally centred in the test chamber.
requirements.quote: Devices with a length exceeding 600 mm shall be horizontally centred in the test chamber.

requirements.text: In the dust exposure test, the test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours.
requirements.quote: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours.

requirements.text: In the dust exposure test, the dust shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
requirements.quote: The dust shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflective device to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
requirements.quote: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.

requirements.text: For the resistance to corrosion test, the rear retro-reflector shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.

requirements.text: Where the rear retro-reflector has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.quote: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the rear retro-reflector sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.quote: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.

requirements.text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas of the rear retro-reflector, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
requirements.quote: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.

requirements.text: Before measuring the coefficient of retro-reflection RA after the corrosion test, the surface of the rear retro-reflector shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
requirements.quote: Before measuring, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.

requirements.text: For the test of resistance of the accessible rear face, the reverse side of the rear retro-reflector shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
requirements.quote: The reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.

requirements.text: After the rear face of the rear retro-reflector (a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA) has been brushed, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute.
requirements.quote: After having brushed in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA the rear face of the retro-reflective device, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture, defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute.

requirements.text: After the cotton cloth has been applied for one minute, the cotton cloth shall be removed and the rear retro-reflector left to dry.
requirements.quote: The cotton cloth is then removed and the retro-reflective device left to dry.

requirements.text: As soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side of the rear retro-reflector shall be brushed with the same brush as before.
requirements.quote: As soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side shall be brushed with the same brush as before.

requirements.text: After the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink, the RI of the rear retro-reflector shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.

requirements.text: For the resistance to fuels test, using a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol, the outer surface of the rear retro-reflector and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.

requirements.text: After about five minutes from wiping with the test mixture, the surface of the rear retro-reflector shall be inspected visually and shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.quote: After about five minutes, the surface shall be inspected visually. It must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.

requirements.text: For the resistance to lubricating oils test of the rear retro-reflector (a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA), the outer surface of the rear retro-reflector and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.

requirements.text: After about 5 minutes from wiping with the detergent lubricating oil, the surface of the rear retro-reflector shall be cleaned.
requirements.quote: After about 5 minutes, the surface shall be cleaned.

requirements.text: After the surface has been cleaned following the lubricating oil test, the RI of the rear retro-reflector shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The RI shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which it may be subjected, it retains the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enables the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be so fitted that it is not possible for it to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the rear retro-reflector, when fitted to the vehicle, shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.quote: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road; in addition it shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices. In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the rear retro-reflector, when fitted to the vehicle, shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.quote: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road; in addition it shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices. In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be fitted in compliance with any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the rear retro-reflector shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear retro-reflectors constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.quote: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.);

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear retro-reflectors constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, except that this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.quote: Be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp;

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear retro-reflectors constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear retro-reflectors constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except that this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.quote: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the rear retro-reflectors shall satisfy the above requirements so far as is possible.
requirements.quote: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical the above requirements shall be satisfied so far as is possible.

requirements.text: While lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, the lamps shall fulfil all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any.
requirements.quote: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.

requirements.text: When all other functions with which the lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF, the lamp shall fulfil its photometric and colorimetric requirements.
requirements.quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them and the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON, each of these other functions shall fulfil its requirements regarding colour.
requirements.quote: However, when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis. These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of two lamps or two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that: (a) Either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of two lamps or two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground of the rear retro-reflector shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, except that where the (maximum and minimum) height above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis. Where the (maximum and minimum) height above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of the rear retro-reflector with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.quote: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.

requirements.text: The position of the rear retro-reflector, as regards width, shall be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle when referred to the overall width, and from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps, except that where the position, as regards width, clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.quote: The position, as regards width, will be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle when referred to the overall width, and from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps. Where the position, as regards width, clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by the rear retro-reflector fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: To verify paragraphs 5.10.1. and 5.10.2., there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of the rear retro-reflector if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: The concealment of the rear retro-reflector shall be prohibited.
requirements.quote: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall be red.
requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where the rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component, the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. shall be fulfilled.
requirements.quote: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.

requirements.text: Where the rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component, the rear retro-reflector shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
requirements.quote: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the rear retro-reflector installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.quote: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.

requirements.text: When the rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the rear retro-reflector shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.quote: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear retro-reflector shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".

requirements.text: If the requirement that the apparent surface of the rear retro-reflector not be hidden more than 50 per cent is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the rear retro-reflector shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or 5.21.2.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the rear retro-reflector observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles if they were already presented when the rear retro-reflector was type-approved.
requirements.quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. However, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.

requirements.text: If measurements are taken closer to the rear retro-reflector, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.quote: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.

requirements.text: If, when the rear retro-reflector is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the rear retro-reflector is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the rear retro-reflector not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.quote: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.

requirements.text: When installed on a vehicle, the rear retro-reflector shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be present on motor vehicles.
requirements.quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be two in number, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be positioned in width such that that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane is not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For vehicles of all categories other than M1 and N1, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm above the ground, except that the maximum height is not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), and 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively.
requirements.quote: In height: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a geometric visibility of 30° inwards and outwards in the horizontal angle.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 30° inwards and outwards.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a geometric visibility of 10° above and below horizontal in the vertical angle, except that where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below horizontal. However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Rearwards.

requirements.text: The position of the rear retro-reflector, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The values measured for the distances of the rear retro-reflector shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to the rear retro-reflector are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: The values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.

regulations.rationale: Consolidated device regulation that approves retro-reflectors of Class IA, which is exactly this product. (lexical: term match score 4.4)
Installation regulation for lighting and retro-reflective devices on M-category vehicles; it sets the requirements for fitting two rear retro-reflectors on the M1 car. (lexical: term match score 8.7)
Legacy retro-reflector device regulation that R150 replaces; the newer consolidated regulation is preferred. (lexical: term match score 0.8; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
Covers external projections of the whole vehicle body, which the vehicle maker assesses; it does not approve this device. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Covers light-signalling lamps, not passive retro-reflectors. (lexical: term match score 0.7)

Covers retro-reflective marking materials for heavy vehicles (M2, M3, N, O), not retro-reflectors on M1; it is also superseded by R150. (lexical: term match score 0.0; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
Covers bumper protective-device behaviour at the vehicle level; not the reflector. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Position and stop lamps are lamps, not passive retro-reflectors. (lexical: term match score 0.0; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
Passive device with no electronics, so EMC does not apply. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Lighting installation for L3 vehicles; wrong vehicle category. (lexical: term match score 0.3)
Reversing lamps; not this product. (lexical: term match score 0.0; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
Direction indicators are a different lamp type. (lexical: term match score 0.0; superseded by a consolidated regulation)

profile.product: Rear retro-reflector (non-triangular, Class IA, red). A passive device with no light source and no electrical connection. Two units are fitted, one at each rear corner of the bumper.
functions: Passive conspicuity: reflects light from other vehicles' headlamps back towards its source
parts: Retro-reflecting optical unit (moulded prism optics, moulded as one part with the red filter)
materials: Retro-reflector optics: PMMA (red, molded prism optics)
Backing plate: ABS or ASA, ultrasonically welded
